title: Full Automation Hub
features:
⚙️ THE COMPANY · full feature list

🎯 **Role Sniper**
- queue any roles and auto-claim them the second a seat opens, in your priority order
- race mode catches seat changes and re-polls fast to win contested seats, with rate-limit backoff
- auto-upgrade to a higher queued role if it opens while you hold a lower one
- auto-reclaim re-grabs your seat if you get kicked out
- adjustable scan delay + live status (held role, open seats, last reply)

🧠 **CEO automation**
- auto-handle proposals: approve/reject on your rank's rules, reject over-budget, boost to your tier's target level
- optimal mode: spends only the day's earned surplus with a quality gate so capital only climbs, with a budget meter
- smart branch routing: sends approved proposals to the weakest city that fits
- auto-create proposals, task auto-staffing, dry-run test mode, full CEO event log
- humanized delays + fail-safes (3-fail stop, never spends influence it can't confirm)

👥 **Staffing**
- rebalance: moves players off overloaded branches onto the ones short of your min-per-city
- metric-driven: concentrates staff in the highest-paying branches and drains NYC into weaker cities
- move cooldown + live staffing log

📋 **Requirements**
- per-tier proposal level targets, max capital, R&D cap, min staff per city, open-branch threshold
- save your reqs and copy them to clipboard

📊 **Dashboard & Analytics**
- live cash / influence / heads ticker
- profits, expenses, capital + daily % and trend sparklines
- your role, promotion, exp + influence with daily rates
- city table (turnover, morale, efficiency, risk, innovation) with weak cities flagged
- branch open/close recommendations + severity-ranked suggested actions

🏛️ **Executive tools**
- chiefs graded on their department stats
- board keep/warn/fire calls for the CEO and chiefs with reasoning
- CEO brief: health verdict, financials, worst-city stats
- one-tap copy of board-hearing, shareholder, CEO and BoD messages

🧑‍💼 **Personnel & Summon**
- multi-select your department or any in-server player by role
- summon selected people on an adjustable cooldown, stop/clear any time

🛒 **Shop / Teleport / Office**
- claim all consumables with cash
- teleport to every floor
- find premium offices to teleport to, sorted by rank + furniture
- copy another office you stand in (only items you own), buy-missing and place it in yours
- save/apply named layouts with a layouts manager

⚙️ **Settings**
- rebindable show/hide key (PC) + floating button (mobile)
- anti-AFK, auto-accept events, proposal alerts, copy mode, window scaling, unload
- once-per-session intro splash, full mobile layout
